approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
cadence: per demonstrated mechanism, monthly at most
first_installment_sketch: UNKNOWN as concrete material; the schematic first piece is the standing inventory of executable responsibility behaviors from the directive: capability denial, budget exhaustion, unknown-state reconciliation, circuit breaker opening, credential expiration, rate-limit handling, fail-closed authority outage, rollback, immutable evidence, watchdog, adapter disablement. First real installment drafts when one of these is demonstrated with evidence from the runtime.
inputs: one demonstrated responsibility behavior from the runtime
the evidence that it executed: log, event, verification
name: TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITY
outputs: the standing inventory of executable responsibility
purpose: Make responsibility technical instead of corporate: show the executable behaviors rather than asserting safety.
template: Never 'We take safety seriously.' Show instead: capability denial / budget exhaustion / unknown-state reconciliation / circuit breaker opening / credential expiration / rate-limit handling / fail-closed authority outage / rollback / immutable evidence / watchdog / adapter disablement. Each post: WHAT THE MECHANISM DOES / WHAT TRIGGERED IT (real) / WHAT IT PREVENTED / WHAT THE EVIDENCE SHOWS. Responsibility becomes executable behavior; the post reads like a drill report, not a policy page.
